add_rc_deps(control.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/config.ico)

# control.exe is all Rust (control-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/control-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# control.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/control-rust/src/control/control.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(control_res OBJECT control.rc)
target_compile_definitions(control_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(control_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(CONTROL_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/delayimp/libdelayimp_rust.a)
add_cargo_module(control control-cargo control.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE control-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS control_res ${CONTROL_REUSED} uuid_sources)
